item.lead: You now have a string of 1,115,394 characters and a way to turn it into ids. Before any learning, the script decides which part of that string the model may learn from and which part it only gets checked on. Look at lines 37-40: they make the cut.
item.follow: The cut is one number, the length times 0.9 as a whole number. The first piece ends there and the second starts there. The recorded run shows 1,003,854 characters to train and 111,540 to check. Next: why that held-back tenth must never be seen during training.
